lookThrough.title: Look-through
lookThrough.caption: Covers priced market instruments only (ETFs, stocks, crypto).
lookThrough.emptyHint: Add a factsheet breakdown for this instrument to see it here.
lookThrough.benchmarkTooltip: Deviation from the world market in percentage points

targetVsActual.title: Target vs. actual
targetVsActual.scopeNote: Tradeable positions only — real estate, vehicles and loans are excluded here.
targetVsActual.clearHint: Leaving every field empty removes the targets.

etfSplit.title: ETF split: developed vs. emerging
etfSplit.clearHint: Clearing the field removes the target.
etfSplit.emergingShareColumn: Right column: each fund's emerging share
etfSplit.emptyHint: The split appears here once funds are held.

concentration.title: Concentration & structure
concentration.subtitle: Two portfolios can both be 70 % equity while one holds forty funds and the other holds two. These are the figures that tell them apart.
concentration.lookThroughCaveat: Counted per instrument, not through funds to what they hold — two funds that overlap still count separately.
concentration.currencyHint: The currency each instrument is quoted in. A euro-quoted fund holding dollar assets still counts as EUR here.
concentration.liquidityHint: From each instrument's liquidity tier. Anything without one set — cash balances included — stays under “Not classified” rather than being assumed into a tier.
